name: How long does a typical flooring installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flooring installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooring installation project varies significantly based on the material, the size of the area, and any necessary subfloor preparation. For example, a small room with laminate might take 1-2 days, while a large area with complex tile work or hardwood requiring acclimation could take a week or more. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project. This estimate will cover preparation, installation, and any finishing work to ensure minimal disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on material and area size; a small room might take 1-2 days, while larger or more complex projects can take a week or more.
